definitions.explanation: The state or process of something increasing in intensity, level, or degree. Used for abstract concepts like emotions, awareness, tension, or demand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I can feel the rising expectations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり⟦とともに→とともに：30485_totomoni⟧、⟦ジム→ジム：04735_jimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: As health awareness grew, more people started going to gyms.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境問題|かんきょうもんだい}→環境問題：10136_kankyoumondai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}した→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧。
examples.english: In response to the growing concern over environmental issues, the government announced new policies.

notes:
The noun form of the intransitive verb ⟦{高|たか}まる→高まる：02066_takamaru⟧ (to rise/intensify). Typically used with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify what is rising.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり (rising expectations)
- ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり (growing interest)
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり (heightened awareness)
- ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり (mounting tension)
- ⟦{需要|じゅよう}→需要：02616_juyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり (surge in demand)

USAGE:
Primarily used for abstract or emotional things that intensify. Frequently appears in news articles and formal writing. The pattern 「X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高|たか}まり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧」 (in response to the rise of X) is especially common in news reporting.
